top_signals.title: India sells air defense missiles to Tajikistan, Turkmenistan in Central Asia push
top_signals.summary: New Delhi is seeking new customers in a region long supplied by Russia and increasingly by China.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Fed’s Hammack Says Smaller, Frequent Rate Adjustments Preferable
top_signals.summary: Federal Reserve Bank of Cleveland President Beth Hammack said smaller, more frequent adjustments to policy can help inflation expectations remain anchored, but she stopped short of backing a rate increase this month.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.
